figures.caption: Fig. 4. The time series of the electrode height is shown in (a). The higher the applied pressure, the more compressed the final SE layer thickness. The relative density of the final SE layer is plotted with the mold pres­ sure in (b), and the simulations are compared with the experimental results of Sakuda et al. [12]. The effect of the AM fraction in the elec­ trode on the relative density is shown in (c). The higher the AM fraction, the lower the final density of the electrode. The SE coverage of AM is plotted in (d). The higher the AM fraction, the lower is the SE coverage on the available AM surface.
